name: Caleb Ruminer
bio: Caleb Ruminer is an American actor best known for his prominent roles across television dramas, thriller films, and streaming series.Born on May 25, 1993, in Cabot, Arkansas, Ruminer developed an early passion for acting before making his screen debut in 2013. He earned his first television credit guest-starring as a young version of John Henson in an episode of the ABC crime-comedy series Castle.Ruminer secured his breakout role in 2014 when he was cast as Cameron "Crash" Mason in the MTV teen drama series, Finding Carter. Appearing in 19 episodes across the show's two seasons, his portrayal of a troubled yet reforming juvenile delinquent captured significant fan and critical attention. Following this success, he starred alongside Dina Meyer in the Lifetime thriller television film Lethal Seduction (2015).Ruminer has consistently expanded his resume with recurring guest spots on high-profile television series. His notable episodic credits include appearances in Bravo's true-crime anthology Dirty John, NBC's psychological thriller The Irrational, and CBS's action drama S.W.A.T.. He expanded his streaming footprint by joining the cast of Ryan Murphy’s acclaimed Netflix anthology series, Monster, portraying Special Agent John Douglas.

credits.title: Remain
credits.overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Kai's life is predicted to end in 3 days. He questions his legacy and meaning after an oracle informs him of his imminent death. Racing the clock, Kai prioritizes what matters most before his foretold demise.
